content: PLEXUS TECHNICAL FINDINGS (Oct 30 2026). GEMINI: rate limits apply per Google PROJECT, not per API key (a second key in the same project gives no extra quota; Bhumika's key must be in her own project). Per-model RPM/TPM/RPD are no longer in public docs; they are shown only on the logged-in page aistudio.google.com/rate-limit (pick the project that holds the key). Free tier: Google may use prompts to improve its products and humans may review them, so only fake seed data goes in, and the pitch must not claim zero data retention. TEST RESULTS from gemini-test.js (a single-file Node script, 10 RFP questions per call, JSON schema reply, run 5 times): model gemini-3.6-flash: 200 OK on 3 of 5 runs, each correct (valid JSON, 8/8 answerable questions correct, the 2 unanswerable ones flagged), about 7 seconds per call, 1,472 to 1,885 tokens per call; the other 2 runs failed with HTTP 503 "high demand" (transient server load, not quota), so retry with backoff is mandatory. Model gemini-pro-latest: all 5 calls HTTP 429 quota exceeded within about half a second, which suggests no free-tier quota, so do not use it. DECISION: use gemini-3.6-flash for both FAST and SMART slots (extraction, receipts via vision, briefings); add a second flash/lite model as GEMINI_MODEL_FALLBACK after 3 failed tries; retry on 503 and 429 (about 2s, 4s, 8s); run batches 2 at a time; Demo Mode replays recorded JSON. At ~7 s per 10-question call, 50 questions is about 35 s sequentially (untested if parallel). MEKO: a TypeScript or script client authenticates with an API key only (no OAuth): generate it in Meko portal Settings > API Keys > Generate (key starts mko_tkn_, shown only once, expires after 1 year, scoped to the account not one datapack). Send two headers on every request to https://mcp.mekodata.ai/mcp: `Authorization: Bearer mko_tkn_...` and `User-Agent: meko-mcp-installer/1.0`. Do not use X-Api-Key or MEKO_API_KEY as header names; do not configure OAuth and the key together. Meko tool quirks seen from Claude: every tool call needs a conversation_id (create with conversation_create, which takes an agent_id and optional datapack_id). Meko-hosted AMP databases need the Pro tier, so app data lives in local SQLite. Mahi's account: Mahi Garg, mahigarg0403@gmail.com. content: PLEXUS RFP DEBUG AND TEST RESULTS, SAT OCT 31 2026 (afternoon IST). ROOT CAUSE of the earlier "filled 0, flagged 50": the Gemini call returned HTTP 400 "API key not valid". Two causes: Mahi had not saved .env.local after fixing the key, and PowerShell still had GEMINI_API_KEY set to the placeholder "new-key" from an earlier example (shell env vars override .env.local). Fix: `Remove-Item Env:GEMINI_API_KEY` (also clear any GEMINI_MODEL), save .env.local, restart. Retrieval was always fine (21 chunks across Q1-Q10). `scripts/rfp-debug.ts` loads .env.local itself; `scripts/rfp-test.ts` does not, so run it as `npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/rfp-test.ts`. Delete `fixtures\rfp-*` before each real re-run so withReplay does not replay stale files. DEBUG OUTPUT after the key fix: Gemini OK, Zod OK, all 10 rows coverage=full confidence=1.0 status=filled, answers contain specific correct facts. Every row has confidence 1.0, so confidence carries no signal; flagging is driven by the coverage field (full/partial/none). Do not show a confidence number as a deck feature; describe flagging by coverage. FULL TEST (50 questions, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite): run 1 filled 36, flagged 14, correct 42, wrongly_filled 8, wrongly_flagged 0; run 2 filled 36, flagged 14, correct 41, wrongly_filled 9. Q37-Q50 (partial and out-of-scope) were all flagged correctly; no answerable question was flagged. SCORER FALSE NEGATIVES: rows Q1, Q4, Q7, Q8, Q18, Q25, Q30, Q33 were scored wrong, but side-by-side reading shows the agent answers are correct: the word-match scorer fails on wording differences ("MFA" vs "multi-factor authentication", "1 Jan" vs "1 January") and on extra facts in the key that the question did not ask for (dates, sign-offs, counts). Wording varies between runs (Q4 failed in run 2 only). Do not loosen the scorer to hit a number; Bhumika's hand-check of the filled answers gives the real accuracy figure for the deck (28 of 35 under the strict scorer is NOT a number to quote). REAL PROBLEM: Q36 (Partial in the key) was filled with coverage=full ("No, ... DR copies are in Singapore"), because the prompt in agents/rfp.ts buildBatchPrompt had no definitions of full/partial/none. The learning-loop demo depends on Q36 being flagged (human-fix Meridian Q36, Q40, Q43, then Aegis Q3, Q8, Q14 should reuse from memory). FIX GIVEN to Mahi (applied? re-run result not yet reported): (1) replace the opening lines of the prompt with explicit rules: full = chunks answer every part and contain everything a customer needs to rely on it; partial = chunks answer only part, OR the honest answer reveals a gap between what the customer asks and what we do and the chunks contain no policy/option/next step for the gap; none = chunks do not answer; for partial/none still draft an answer if the chunks allow, else null. (2) bug in runRfp: `window.map` returned the promise without await inside try/catch so a failing batch would crash the run; use `async (batch, j) => { try { return await processBatch(...) } catch { return { filled: 0, flagged: batch.length } } }`. CHECK AFTER RE-RUN: Q36 flagged, wrongly_filled 0, none of Q1-Q35 flipped to flagged; run twice if time. If Q36 still fills, fall back to Q37-Q43 for the demo red cells and have Bhumika re-point the three linked Aegis questions. Optional later: prompt truncates each chunk at 500 characters (chunk.content.slice(0, 500)); try about 1000. NEXT: after Q36 passes, backend prompts 3-8 (guard and audit, ActionSwarm, access agent, Cmd+K and Catch-Me-Up, finance) as BACKEND AND API ONLY with a JSON contract per endpoint for Bhumika's screens; the other Claude chat and Mahi have not confirmed that yet. Mahi rotated the Meko API key (done).

RULES FOR THE AI: TypeScript strict; one module per prompt; patches to named files, not rewrites; validate every model output with Zod (retry once with the error, then return a flagged result); batch RFP questions 10 per call; retry with exponential backoff on 503 and 429; every real response saved to fixtures/ and DEMO_MODE=true replays it via withReplay(key, fn) in lib/replay.ts; every action emits one ActivityEvent and one audit_events row; never log keys; show clear errors in the feed; add a run command or test per module; check current library docs before using any API. FOLDER LAYOUT: plexus/{app/(dashboard)/{rfp,actions,access,search,finance,audit}, app/api, agents/{rfp,actionswarm,access,finance,search}.ts, guard/{guard,injection,policies}.ts, lib/{gemini,meko,db,replay,events,xlsx}.ts, components/{ActivityFeed,RfpGrid,ApprovalCard,TraceDrawer,CmdK}, data/, fixtures/, .env.local}. ENV NAMES: GEMINI_API_KEY, GEMINI_MODEL_FAST, GEMINI_MODEL_SMART, GEMINI_MODEL_FALLBACK, MEKO_MCP_URL, MEKO_AUTH (the mko_tkn_ key), MEKO_DATAPACK_ID, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_APP_TOKEN, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_URL, DATABASE_PATH, CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.85, DEMO_MODE. ACTIVITY EVENT: {id, timestamp, agent (rfp|actionswarm|access|finance|search|guard), action, status (done|flagged|blocked|pending_approval|undone|error), confidence?, sources[{title,ref}], traceId, undoable}. SQLITE TABLES: users(id,name,role,manager_id); questionnaires(id,customer,uploaded_at,total); rfp_questions(id,questionnaire_id,number,question,answer,confidence,status filled|flagged|human_fixed,source_ref,human_answer,reused_from_fix); tasks(id,title,assignee,due,source_event,status); access_requests(id,user_id,app,risk,status granted|pending|rejected|revoked,approver_id,requested_at,decided_at); expenses(id,merchant,date,gst,total,category,policy_flag,duplicate_of,card_txn_id); saas_billing(tool,monthly_cost_inr,owner,seats); sso_logins(tool,user_id,last_login); audit_events(id,timestamp,agent,action,status,confidence,sources_json,trace_id,undo_state,payload_json).
